import { motion, useReducedMotion, useReducedMotionConfig } from 'motion/react'
import { useId, type ElementType, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** OS setting, or forced on with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="always">. */
function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const os = useReducedMotion()
  const forced = useReducedMotionConfig()
  return Boolean(os || forced)
}

export interface FeatureRow {
  /** Headline of the row. */
  title: string
  /** Copy of the row. */
  description: ReactNode
  /** Mock-up, screenshot or illustration. */
  media: ReactNode
  /** Small link under the copy. */
  link?: { label: string; href: string }
}

export interface FeaturesAlternatingProps {
  /** Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech. */
  title: ReactNode
  /** Copy under the headline. */
  description?: ReactNode
  /** Rows, top to bottom. The media side swaps on every other row. */
  features: FeatureRow[]
  /** Element for the headline. */
  titleAs?: ElementType
  /** Element for the root. */
  as?: ElementType
  /** Seconds each half takes to slide in. */
  duration?: number
  /** Turns the entrance animation off. */
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}

/** Zig-zag rows: copy on one side, media on the other, swapping sides down the page. */
export function FeaturesAlternating({
  title,
  description,
  features,
  titleAs: Title = 'h2',
  as: Tag = 'section',
  duration = 0.6,
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: FeaturesAlternatingProps) {
  const id = useId()
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion()
  const animate = !disabled && !reduced
  const ease = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const

  return (
    <Tag aria-labelledby={id} className={cn('@container w-full', className)}>
      <div className="mx-auto mb-14 flex max-w-2xl flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
        <Title id={id} className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance text-foreground @xl:text-4xl">
          {title}
        </Title>
        {description != null && <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-pretty text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-16 @3xl:gap-24">
        {features.map((f, i) => {
          const reversed = i % 2 === 1
          const from = reversed ? 24 : -24
          return (
            <div key={f.title} className="grid items-center gap-8 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-14">
              <motion.div
                initial={animate ? { opacity: 0, x: from } : false}
                whileInView={animate ? { opacity: 1, x: 0 } : undefined}
                viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-80px' }}
                transition={{ duration, ease }}
                className={cn('flex flex-col items-start gap-3', reversed && '@3xl:order-2')}
              >
                <h3 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">{f.title}</h3>
                <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{f.description}</p>
                {f.link && (
                  <a
                    href={f.link.href}
                    className="mt-1 rounded-sm text-sm font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  >
                    {f.link.label}
                  </a>
                )}
              </motion.div>
              <motion.div
                initial={animate ? { opacity: 0, x: -from } : false}
                whileInView={animate ? { opacity: 1, x: 0 } : undefined}
                viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-80px' }}
                transition={{ duration, ease }}
                className="min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-md shadow-foreground/5"
              >
                {f.media}
              </motion.div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </Tag>
  )
}

// Source: educlopez/smoothui (MIT) — https://github.com/educlopez/smoothui/blob/main/packages/smoothui/blocks/features/features-3/index.tsx
import { FeaturesAlternating } from '@/components/features-alternating'

function Art({ variant }: { variant: 1 | 2 | 3 }) {
  return (
    <div aria-hidden className="relative aspect-video w-full bg-linear-to-br from-primary/20 via-muted to-background">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" className="absolute inset-0 size-full" fill="none">
        {variant === 1 && (
          <>
            <circle cx="160" cy="90" r="48" className="stroke-primary" strokeWidth="2" />
            <circle cx="160" cy="90" r="24" className="fill-primary/30" />
            <path d="M40 140h240" className="stroke-border" strokeWidth="2" />
          </>
        )}
        {variant === 2 && (
          <>
            {[60, 100, 140, 180, 220, 260].map((x, i) => (
              <rect key={x} x={x - 12} y={140 - (i + 1) * 16} width="24" height={(i + 1) * 16} rx="4" className={i === 5 ? 'fill-primary' : 'fill-primary/25'} />
            ))}
          </>
        )}
        {variant === 3 && (
          <>
            <rect x="60" y="40" width="200" height="100" rx="10" className="stroke-primary" strokeWidth="2" />
            <path d="M80 70h90M80 90h130M80 110h60" className="stroke-muted-foreground/50" strokeWidth="4" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </>
        )}
      </svg>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function FeaturesAlternatingDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl">
      <FeaturesAlternating
        title="Why teams choose us"
        description="Designed for productivity, built to last."
        features={[
          { title: 'Intuitive by design', description: 'Every screen is made for the first minute of use, so nobody needs a tour.', media: <Art variant={1} />, link: { label: 'Read the design notes', href: '#' } },
          { title: 'Fast where it counts', description: 'Only transform and opacity animate, so interfaces stay smooth on modest hardware.', media: <Art variant={2} /> },
          { title: 'A joy for developers', description: 'Typed props, copy-paste installs and docs that stay out of your way.', media: <Art variant={3} />, link: { label: 'Browse the docs', href: '#' } },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
